name: Sodium cocoamphoacetate
description: Sodium cocoamphoacetate (CAS 68610-43-5 ) is an amphoteric surfactant derived from coconut oil fatty acids, used across personal care and industrial cleaning formulations. It delivers mildness, foam enhancement, and chelating activity within a single ingredient. This versatile chemical reduces the need for separate additives in complex mixtures. In shampoos, body washes, and facial cleansers, it boosts foam density from primary surfactants such as sodium lauryl sulfate. By incorporating this surfactant, manufacturers can lower the overall irritation profile of the system. Liquid hand soaps and mild cleansing formulations use it to maintain skin compatibility at higher surfactant concentrations. In household and industrial hard-surface cleaners, its chelating capacity helps sequester calcium and magnesium ions. This functionality significantly improves cleaning performance in hard water environments. Textile and leather processing operations use it as a low-irritation emulsifier and detergent component. It is frequently utilized in scouring and finishing baths to ensure high-quality material processing. The product is supplied as an aqueous liquid, typically in the 35–40% active matter range. Technical and cosmetic grades are available, with cosmetic-grade material meeting the purity requirements for personal care. Standard supply formats for industrial and formulation-scale procurement include drum and IBC packaging.
